title: Introduction To Public Health Laws
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
Tutor Marked Assignment The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those laws which are regarded as indigenous to members of a given community based on their customs and tradition which regulate affairs of the members since time immemorial."

Customary Law Customary law are those laws which are regarded as indigenous to members of a given community based on their customs and tradition which regulate affairs of the members since time immemorial.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a statute, ordinance or code that prescribes sanitary standards and regulations for the purpose of preserving and promoting community's health."
Health law refers to a statute, ordinance or code that prescribes sanitary standards and regulations for the purpose of preserving and promoting community's health.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the presence of any matter whether solid, liquid or gas that is capable of affecting the enjoyment of a healthy environment and can cause injury or threat to public health."
Nuisance can be defined as the presence of any matter whether solid, liquid or gas that is capable of affecting the enjoyment of a healthy environment and can cause injury or threat to public health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a defence for most criminal offences under section 24 of Criminal Code (Okonkwo and Nash, 2003)."
Accident is a defence for most criminal offences under section 24 of Criminal Code (Okonkwo and Nash, 2003).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of rules, remedies, and sanctions as the case may be related to health."
Public Health Law (PHL) is a collection of rules, remedies, and sanctions as the case may be related to health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a claim by an accused of the existence of certain facts that exonerate him from criminal liability (Okonkwo and Nash, 2003)."
A defence is a claim by an accused of the existence of certain facts that exonerate him from criminal liability (Okonkwo and Nash, 2003).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool or an instrument of political, economic and social change and stability."
Public health law is a tool or an instrument of political, economic and social change and stability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major source of law because it defines and contains all the intent and provisions as well as the limitation of the law."
Statute is a major source of law because it defines and contains all the intent and provisions as well as the limitation of the law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined and the punishment is not stated the accused cannot be punished or convicted of that offence."
Even where the offence is defined and the punishment is not stated the accused cannot be punished or convicted of that offence.
